title: Data Processing: Dataflow & Dataproc — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces Dataflow Streaming Engine Watermark Traversal: event-time windowing, handling late-arriving data, and emitting aggregated metrics to BigQuery.
routing_rationale: Event-time watermarking ensures calculations remain accurate even when mobile or IoT devices experience intermittent connectivity and submit delayed timestamps.

steps.title: Event-Time Processing
steps.action: Dataflow assigns event to [10:00-10:05) window based on click time, not arrival time.
steps.why_traversal: Preserves analytical integrity regardless of network transmission latency.

steps.title: Late Data Accumulation

steps.why_traversal: Eliminates inaccurate business metrics caused by delayed client submissions.
